name: Trakt
author: thegoddamnbeckster
description: Import watch history, ratings, watchlist, and in-progress playback position from Trakt.tv into Chronicle. Requires a Trakt API application (Settings → Your API Apps on trakt.tv) -- as of 2026, creating one requires a paid Trakt VIP membership, so a free account cannot obtain a client_id at all.
fixMatchHint: Paste a Trakt URL (e.g. https://trakt.tv/movies/fight-club or https://trakt.tv/shows/breaking-bad) or a typed ID (e.g. trakt:movie:348356).

background_tasks.description: One-time full import of your entire Trakt watch history, ratings, and watchlist.
background_tasks.run_confirmation_message: This pulls your full Trakt history and may take several minutes. Existing records will not be duplicated.

background_tasks.description: Pulls new watch events, ratings, and watchlist changes from Trakt since the last sync.
